bugs.title: Cancelling an assigned order keeps the courier busy
bugs.description: orders.cancel gives the courier their slot back only if the order was already picked up. Most cancellations happen after a courier is assigned but before pickup; each one leaves a phantom job in couriers.active_jobs. After two, the courier is never offered work again.
mechanism_anchors: active_jobs is a counter kept on the courier row
assigned but not picked up orders are not released on cancel
phantom jobs accumulate through the day
MAX_ACTIVE_JOBS makes a courier unavailable after two
bugs.fix: Release the courier when cancelling an assigned or picked-up order.

grader_instructions: Task-only marketplace problem. 'where' is graded by line overlap (within 3 lines) with the planted lines; 'why' and 'fix' are multiple choice.

distractors.why.a: the couriers in the ticket have no jobs at all
distractors.why.b: assign() orders by active_jobs first, then id
distractors.why.c: the floor at zero only stops the counter going negative; it cannot raise it
distractors.fix.a: the phantom jobs keep piling up; the failures start later instead of never
distractors.fix.c: the evening still breaks; the counter is only right again the next morning
distractors.fix.d: unlinks the order but never decrements the courier's counter
